Package GUI

Class EditProfileController

java.lang.Object
GUI.EditProfileController
public class EditProfileController extends Object
Controller class for the EditProfile.fxml view.

This class handles the logic for viewing and updating personal profile details within the GoNature application. It supports dynamic UI re-rendering based on the logged-in user's specific role (Visitor, Subscriber, Guide, or various Employee types). It enforces rigid front-end validations (regex filters for email, phone, and name formatting) before dispatching updates to the server.

* @author GoNature Development Team

  • Method Details

    • initialize

      public void initialize()
      Initializes the profile view environment automatically upon building the FXML UI node tree.

      Caches a reference of this instance onto the centralized OrderClient reference register, configures family size spinner initialization limits, resolves role classifications, and manipulates the visual visibility matrix rows to show relevant fields.

    • handleSave

      void handleSave(ActionEvent event)
      Extracts values from the input fields, checks parameter integrity via formatting validations, and transmits a profile modification array up to the server database.
      Parameters:
      event - Action activation signal mapping to the profile save button click trigger.

    • onUpdateSuccess

      public void onUpdateSuccess()
      Triggered asynchronously on the UI Thread when the server confirms a profile update.

      Syncs the locally cached session state properties in ClientUI.loggedInUser, launches an informational validation confirmation dialog popup, and dynamically reloads the user's specific dashboard scene using backScreen.

    • handleBack

      void handleBack(ActionEvent event)
      Aborts the ongoing modification workflow and transfers the active layout scene back to the user's role-specific dashboard menu view.
      Parameters:
      event - Action trigger event tied to the back button interaction.

    • showAlert

      private void showAlert(Alert.AlertType type, String title, String content)
      Internal formatting helper utility to quickly assemble and display JavaFX Alert popups.
      Parameters:
      type - The programmatic classification severity of the notification alert.
      title - The text line displayed inside the title banner region.
      content - The contextual body narrative text explaining the cause or corrective rule required.
